dustShedGreenhouse: During storms, lower greenhouse light to save power for air and heat.
batteryWaste: You wasted solar energy. A bigger battery stores it for the night.
speNoShelter: Next time a solar storm is forecast, move the crew to the storm shelter.
speNoShelterModule: Build a Storm Shelter before the next solar storm. It blocks 90% of the radiation.
recyclerUpgrade: Upgrading the water recycler saves more water than it costs.
dustyPanels: Your panels are dusty. Cleaning them gives back {pct}% power.
nightBattery: Your battery ran out during the night. A bigger battery bank keeps systems running until sunrise.
lifeSupportShed: Life support did not get full power. Keep it at the top of the priority list and cut the lab or greenhouse first.
foodLow: Food is running low. Expand the greenhouse early — new beds need 10 days to grow.
doseHigh: Radiation is adding up. Regolith shielding lowers the dose every single day.
moduleDown: Broken equipment is costing you. An Engineer on Maintenance repairs it in 1 day.
labNoResearcher: The lab used power but nobody was doing research. Assign someone to Research or dim the lab.
shadowPrepare: In a shadow period, the battery is your only power. Dim everything except air, heat and water.
